# JobTrack-AI

> Smart job search and AI resumes for students and freshers.

JobTrack-AI helps students discover internships and jobs, build ATS-friendly resumes tailored to each role, and track every application in one place.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Product overview and how it works
- [Features](/features): AI resume builder, job matcher, tracker, cover letters
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free and Premium plans
- [About](/about): Mission and team
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about ATS, AI resumes, and security
